title: Sphinx enclosure filled in and excavated by Thutmose IV, used to argue for an older Sphinx

tellings.quote: No, that's totally ignoring the fact that a thousand years later, Tutmos IV says it was covered, says it had filled in and he had to excavate all of it and clean out the Sphinx enclosure to become the pharaoh.

plain: The Sphinx is said to be older than usually thought, because about a thousand years after its supposed building, the pharaoh Thutmose IV recorded that its enclosure, the pit cut around it, had filled in and that he had to dig it all out and clean it before he could become pharaoh. A researcher named Luke Caverns makes this argument on the show, without naming a source. If true, the Sphinx had already been long buried and neglected by Thutmose's time.
